incomeTax.calculatorTagline: Find out how much you pay under the New vs Old tax regimes for FY 2026-27 in under 2 minutes.

step1.title: Step 1: About You
step1.subtitle: Older taxpayers get a higher tax-free limit in the old regime.

below60.title: Below 60
below60.desc: Individual taxpayers under 60 years of age

senior.title: 60 to 79 (Senior citizen)
senior.desc: Higher exemption limit up to ₹3,00,000 in Old Regime

superSenior.title: 80 or above (Super senior citizen)
superSenior.desc: Higher exemption limit up to ₹5,00,000 in Old Regime

step2.title: Step 2: Your Income
step2.subtitle: Enter your salary and other income sources for the full financial year.

salary.title: Salary Income (CTC or Gross Salary)
salary.desc: Income before deductions like PF, tax, and standard deduction

otherIncome.title: Other Income (Bank Interest, FD Interest, etc.)
otherIncome.helper: Standard deduction does not apply to this.
otherIncome.label: Annual Other Income
otherIncome.tooltip: Includes interest from savings accounts, fixed deposits, recurring deposits, or other taxable earnings.
otherIncome.example: Example: ₹25,000 from savings bank and FD interest

step3.title: Step 3: Deductions & Allowances
step3.subtitle: Investments and expenses that reduce your taxable income under the Old Tax Regime.

deductions.bannerMsg: Deductions only help in the OLD regime. We will calculate both and compare for you.
deductions.limitExceededNotice: Only {{limit}} counts. We will use the limit.

sec80C.label: Section 80C Investments
sec80C.tooltip: Covers Employee PF (EPF), PPF, ELSS mutual funds, Life Insurance Premiums, National Savings Certificate (NSC), SSY, and Children Tuition Fees.
sec80C.example: e.g. ₹1,50,000 for EPF contribution + PPF investment

sec80D_self.label: Section 80D - Health Insurance (Self & Family)
sec80D_self.tooltip: Medical insurance premiums and preventive health check-up (up to ₹5,000) for yourself, spouse, and dependent children.
sec80D_self.example: e.g. ₹25,000 yearly premium for family health cover

sec80D_parents.label: Section 80D - Health Insurance (Parents)
sec80D_parents.tooltip: Medical insurance premiums for parents. Limit is ₹25,000 (normal) or ₹50,000 if either parent is 60 years or older.
sec80D_parents.example: e.g. ₹50,000 for senior citizen parents' insurance

sec80CCD1B.label: NPS Contribution - Section 80CCD(1B)
sec80CCD1B.tooltip: Exclusive additional deduction for voluntary contribution to Tier 1 National Pension Scheme (NPS), above the Section 80C ₹1.5L limit.
sec80CCD1B.example: e.g. ₹50,000 deposited in NPS Tier-1 account

homeLoan.label: Home Loan Interest - Section 24(b) (Self-occupied House)
homeLoan.tooltip: Interest paid on home loan borrowed for purchase or construction of a self-occupied residential property. Capped at ₹2,00,000.
homeLoan.example: e.g. ₹2,00,000 interest portion shown on bank home loan certificate

hra.title: House Rent Allowance (HRA)
hra.subtitle: Claim tax exemption on rent paid under Section 10(13A)
hra.basicTooltip: Basic salary component of your CTC for the full year.
hra.receivedTooltip: Total HRA received from your employer in Form 16 / salary slips.
hra.rentTooltip: Actual total rent paid to landlord during the financial year.
